Two-Pillar Discipline & Execution Checklist (2026-11-13 Archive)

Whether reviewing a lifelong 401(k), an IRA, or a taxable brokerage account, three quiet habits protect long-term compounding across market seasons:

First, hold unleveraged 1x spot ETFs ($SMH and $XLV) free from daily 3x leveraged volatility decay. Second, insulate near-term household spending reserves in 0–3 month US Treasury bills ($SGOV) so equity shares are never sold in a downturn. Third, place limit orders rather than market orders during the opening minutes after 9:30 AM ET.
